What you're supposed to do:
1) Cut the pomegranate into quarters
2) Put the quarters into a large bowl, fill bowl with water.
3) Plunge your hands into the bowl, ripping and tearing like the vicious carnivore you are carefully pulling the seeds apart.
4) Tasty seeds will fall to the bottom of the bowl. Remove the flotsam, then drain the bowl.
5) You now have a bowl of lovely pomegranate seeds. You may either eat them daintily one at a time, or devour them by the fistful.

I just posted this as a reply to crab, but here it is again:

Cut through the shell length ways on one side. Once you're through use the knife to score the inside of the opposite side of the shell through the cut. Place your thumbs (and the pad of your palm at the base of your thumb) along either side of the cut and the tips of your fingers on the underside, along the score.

Squeeze your thumbs and fingers together to get a solid grip then roll your thumbs away from each other while pushing up with your fingers. If done correctly the shell will bend along the score and the cut side will split open leaving the meat easily accessible.

edit: with lobster, cut through the underside and score the inside of their back.
